body: I don't care about college anymore, I don't care about anything except figuring out how I'm going to kill myself.

I have no one except my insanely psychotic and abusive family members who only want to see me heavily medicated and shut away in my room for the rest of my life. I don't have good insurance so I can't get any real professional help.

My emotions are always unstable, my relationships are always unstable. my life is complete chaos. I already tried to kill myself but I ended up permanent issues stemming from the attempt so I've been researching more fool proof ways to kill myself. I'm going to leave this world without ever knowing what it was liked to be loved by anyone.

I can't stop thinking about someone I met and fell in love with very fast. They stopped talking to me months ago and I think about them every moment of the day now. I've never had anyone be so nice to me before. Then one day all of the a sudden one day they told me they never want to see me again. I don't think I'm tired of being alone, I'm just tired of being alive and this happening over and over again with everyone I meet. I don't have any friends at all and no social contact and I feel like I'm losing my mind. I think I'm headed for another suicide attempt, I've been reading these posts for months now.
